en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Neither the Jew nor the Christian would inherit the Muslim, but the Muslim would inherit the Jew and the Christian’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu Najran from ‘Asem ibn Humayd from Muhammad ibn Qays who has narrated the following: “
I once heard abu Ja‘far, Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Jews and Christians cannot inherit from the Muslims but a Muslim can inherit from Jews and Christians.’”
